text:
maya: quick UX nitfest for the priority editor before handoff. small things: preview placement, reorder keyboard, and validation copy.

eli: drop bullets pls.

maya: bullets: 1) Move compact Preview into a bottom dock (collapsible). 2) Button label -> "Preview rules" with dropdown sizes: 1 / 10 / 50. 3) Keyboard reorder: Alt+Up/Alt+Down; announce "Moved 'X' to 2 of 6". 4) Validation copy: "Condition format error — expected 'attribute operator value' (e.g., user.email contains 'acme.com')" + small example.

sam: +1 on dock, but default to modal on narrow screens. keep undo toast for reorders: "Moved 'X' to #2 [Undo]" 6s.

nina: a11y: chevrons must be focusable with aria-labels and disabled contrast fixed for 14px. announce preview completion: "Preview complete — 12 matches" in polite aria-live.

ci-bot: branch created: ui/ruleflow/mini-preview-nits by maya. CI build 5078 started. :rocket:

maya: thanks — i'll push updated frames and microcopy. devs flag any API gaps, but preview-runner supports sample_size already.

eli: I'll write the keyboard spec tomorrow and confirm focus behavior.

sam: good. aim for staging canary next week if no blockers.
